what: Stacked panels swap at each every-second interval. At the moment of swapping, the next panel is laid underneath, and the current panel, with its left edge slanted 7%, wipes off to the right after a delay(1s) over 1.6s with cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1). A cleared panel returns to the very bottom on the next turn. Each swap fires fx:slide, which the consuming side uses to tie in the next panel’s entrance (pie chart drawing, photo settling)

options.first: Seconds from sticking or receiving fx:play until the first swap, default every — 0 means immediately
options.delay: Seconds until clearing starts after the swap, default 1
options.start: If wait, it pauses until fx:play arrives (starts after the Hero opening)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Boards to overlay — direct children of the element, two or more. With two they alternate (graph ↔ photo)
options.fx:play · fx:pause · fx:go: Events sent to the element — start, stop, change right now. Fires fx:slide on every change. { index: next panel, prev: panel peeling away } Floats up

from.where: index.html .ak-fv__list (hero survey cards — 7.6 seconds, delayed 1s then 1.6s) · .ak-q__cover (question row graph↔photo — 6 seconds, 2s, .2s later per row)
